Crop rectangle <code>(138, 624, 1292, 2231)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8f7e522339b88ccf0c5c360446690efe99ad43e74e2d65d2f5ed97e133e1f3ee</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
